headline: 3 Air Force personnel killed in Dhaka airport's Third Terminal crash
summary: A pickup truck lost control and plunged from a flyover at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport, leaving three dead and four injured.
details: Three members of the Bangladesh Air Force were killed after their pickup truck lost control and plunged from a flyover at the Third Terminal of Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport.
The accident occurred on Monday night around 10:20 PM while the personnel were performing their regular duties.
The deceased have been identified as Warrant Officer Mahmud, Corporal Piyas, and LAC Zubaidul.
Four other Air Force members were injured in the crash and have been shifted to the Combined Military Hospital (CMH) in Dhaka for treatment.
The Inter-Services Public Relations (ISPR) confirmed the incident in a statement, noting that the vehicle fell from the second floor of the terminal's flyover.

Four other Air Force members were injured in the crash and have been shifted to the Combined Military Hospital (CMH) in Dhaka for treatment.

The Inter-Services Public Relations (ISPR) confirmed the incident in a statement, noting that the vehicle fell from the second floor of the terminal's flyover.

headline_marked: End of an era: [[Lionel Messi retires from Argentina national team]]
headline: End of an era: Lionel Messi retires from Argentina national team
summary: After 20 years of service, the football legend bids farewell in a personal handwritten letter, reflecting on a journey of tears, triumph, and ultimate glory.
details: Lionel Messi has announced his retirement from the Argentina national team after two decades of representing his country. The announcement came via a personal, handwritten three-page letter written on a simple notepad.
In his emotional message, Messi stated, "I gave and delivered everything... I emptied myself, I have nothing left," reflecting on the immense pressure and expectations he carried for years.
His international career spanned generations, featuring Olympic glory, the 2021 Copa América title, and the crowning achievement of winning the 2022 World Cup in Qatar.
The farewell was marked by a striking detail: a golden Harry Potter 'Time-Turner' pen used to write the letter, symbolizing a reflection on the past and the journey he traveled.
Messi's decision follows a recent World Cup final in 2026 where Argentina faced Spain in East Rutherford, New Jersey, marking the final chapter of his international journey.
The announcement was accompanied by a video highlighting his evolution from a teenage debutant to a world champion, capturing a legacy that transcends statistics and trophies.
caption:
“I emptied myself, I have nothing left.” 

Lionel Messi bids an emotional farewell to the Argentina national team after 20 years.

Lionel Messi has announced his retirement from the Argentina national team after two decades of representing his country. The announcement came via a personal, handwritten three-page letter written on a simple notepad.

In his emotional message, Messi stated, "I gave and delivered everything... I emptied myself, I have nothing left," reflecting on the immense pressure and expectations he carried for years.

His international career spanned generations, featuring Olympic glory, the 2021 Copa América title, and the crowning achievement of winning the 2022 World Cup in Qatar.

The farewell was marked by a striking detail: a golden Harry Potter 'Time-Turner' pen used to write the letter, symbolizing a reflection on the past and the journey he traveled.

Messi's decision follows a recent World Cup final in 2026 where Argentina faced Spain in East Rutherford, New Jersey, marking the final chapter of his international journey.

The announcement was accompanied by a video highlighting his evolution from a teenage debutant to a world champion, capturing a legacy that transcends statistics and trophies.
